crossRefs.note: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother’s children.
God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard…
“He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.
For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.
For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience…
Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: “There is no fear of God before his eyes.”
Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on God?
They will do these things because they have not known the Father, nor me.

translations.web: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them.
translations.bsb: For strangers rise up against me, and ruthless men seek my life— men with no regard for God. Selah
translations.kjv: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.
translations.asv: For strangers are risen up against me, And violent men have sought after my soul: They have not set God before them. Selah
